title: An open-answer column is called names, and Apply swaps the answers for codes (until Participants merges)
The vault shows locked after the network returns (fixed in #25)
A line break inside a coded passage joins the words (fixed in #25)
The old slides preview and its Download stay live while Generate reads (fixed in #25)
Locked Closeness says "Write at least about 30 words first" (fixed in #25)
The consent form ignores the under-18 answer: no parent's permission and no child's agreement (until Participants merges)
Overview says "Not ready yet" while saved work is still opening
The AI-use statement says the browser sends requests to the provider; Appuscholar's server does
"I planned the argument and the structure myself" is ticked for the student when the tab opens
Keystrokes typed while a Design tab opens its saved work are dropped

At a 1406 px window with the document open beside the place, the eight Design and ethics tabs wrap onto two lines (they fit on one at 1440 px on the walk's Mac and on the dev machine; on CI's Linux Chromium they wrap at 1440 px as well: 858 px needed, 856 px given)
A bar chart with "Axis from" above the data draws the bars under the axis (rule 14 against D-S2-107)
"1 tagged results" on Check numbers: a plural with 1
The personal-details dialog says the text goes straight to the AI provider; it goes through Appuscholar's server first
The dictionary failing tells the student "The dictionary needs the internet"
Tab on the Viva tab inserts AI text, and nothing there says so
The Make PPT download's type is application/zip, not a presentation
The project export window has no accessible name: its title is given an id that the window's aria-labelledby does not point at

Text set in the pale chip colour: the empty circles beside Overview's pieces and the count beside each kind of help on the AI-use statement tab (the class text-muted is the chip background token, #f4f3f6, about 1.1:1 on white)
While the vault is locked, Overview marks all six pieces "Not ready yet" (as O2 does while the work opens), though saved work exists
While the vault is locked, Budget shows "Total: ₹0" and seven empty amount boxes under its locked note, as if nothing had been entered
Amounts typed while the network was off are not sent when it returns: the Design tab says the last save did not go through until another change is made, and a reload asks "Leave site?"
On a phone, the project name in a place's top line is 20 px tall and the "Your question" strip's summary 32 px

On a phone, the Design and ethics tabs' own controls are under 44 px: Overview's seven lines (32 px tall), the tick rows of Pathway, Ethics and consent, Registration, Investigator and the AI-use statement (20 or 40 px tall), and Budget's remove buttons (32 px wide)
On a phone, the document toolbar's Bold, Italic, Underline, bulleted list and numbered list buttons are 32 to 35.5 px wide
On a Hindi page the document toolbar's more-formatting button shows "और ▾" but is named "More formatting" in English
On a Hindi page the document bar and toolbar are in English: the seeded title "My first document" and the toolbar's Paragraph, B I U, Image, Table, Find and Dictate (O9)
While the vault is locked, an amount typed into Budget is dropped: the box takes the key and gives it back empty, with only the locked note above to say why
